This project explores digital advertising performance across Google, Meta, and TikTok, examining how platform and campaign type influence exposure, engagement, and financial outcomes. Using multivariate statistical analysis, data visualization, and a greedy budget optimization algorithm, I identified performance patterns and developed a data-driven approach to allocating a $30,000 advertising budget.
